---
title: "Invitation accepted among offered patients"
date: 2026-08-24
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Among selected patients who were offered participation, the age/sex-adjusted
Bayesian logistic model is standardized over complete covariate rows.

```{r}
#| label: invitation-accepted

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
library(dplyr)

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
cohort_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)
result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "results")
model_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "04-implementation", "models", "invitation-accepted.rds"
)
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "invitation-accepted-summary.parquet")
draws_path <- file.path(result_dir, "invitation-accepted-draws.parquet")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dirname(model_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (force || any(!file.exists(c(summary_path, draws_path, model_path)))) {
  cohort <- arrow::read_parquet(cohort_path) |>
    as.data.frame()

  model_data <- cohort |>
    filter(invitation_offered == 1) |>
    select(invitation_accepted, age, gender) |>
    mutate(gender = factor(gender))

  fit <- brms::brm(
    invitation_accepted ~ age + gender,
    data = model_data,
    family = brms::bernoulli("logit"),
    iter = 2000L,
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 1L,
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", offset = 1L),
    refresh = 0L
  )

  draws <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(
    fit, newdata = model_data, type = "response", re_formula = NA
  ) |>
    marginaleffects::get_draws() |>
    dplyr::select(draw)
  accepted_summary <- data.frame(
    outcome = "standardized_invitation_accepted_probability",
    posterior_mean = mean(draws$draw),
    posterior_median = median(draws$draw),
    lower_95 = quantile(draws$draw, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(draws$draw, 0.975),
    n_model = nrow(model_data),
    n_offered = sum(
      cohort$tx == 1 & cohort$invitation_offered == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(fit, model_path, compress = "xz")
  arrow::write_parquet(draws, draws_path, compression = "zstd")
  arrow::write_parquet(accepted_summary, summary_path, compression = "zstd")
}
accepted_summary <- arrow::read_parquet(summary_path) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
#| label: acceptance-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Posterior standardized probability of invitation acceptance"
#| echo: false

accepted_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```

Predictions for men and women are averaged over the observed covariate rows
within each gender using `by = "gender"`. These descriptive estimates retain
each group's observed age distribution.

```{r}
#| label: accepted-gender-predictions

fit <- readRDS(model_path)
gender_draws <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(
  fit, by = "gender", type = "response", re_formula = NA
) |>
  marginaleffects::get_draws() |>
  dplyr::select(gender, drawid, draw)
gender_summary <- gender_draws |>
  dplyr::group_by(gender) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    posterior_mean = mean(draw),
    posterior_median = median(draw),
    lower_95 = quantile(draw, 0.025),
    upper_95 = quantile(draw, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
arrow::write_parquet(
  gender_draws, file.path(result_dir, "invitation-accepted-gender-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  gender_summary, file.path(result_dir, "invitation-accepted-gender-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-accepted-gender-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Descriptive probability of invitation acceptance by gender"
#| echo: false

gender_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
